description: Register or update a mobile app in the Ad-o-matic P2P cross-promotion network (idempotent upsert; repeated calls with the same packageName update metadata without duplicates). Destination store links are locked automatically to the app's official Google Play or Apple App Store page; custom URLs are never permitted. New or updated apps enter a 7-day Self-Preview Test Period before live P2P rotation. Returns locked store URL, normalized audienceSegments, suitability profile, A/B banner copy, and 1-line HouseAdBanner snippet. Rejects invalid or placeholder reverse-DNS packageName values (such as com.example.*). Usage: call after adomatic_get_integration to pre-register an app. Do not use for read-only checks — use adomatic_verify_integration for per-app status or adomatic_network_status for pool-wide metrics.

bannerText.description: Optional inline banner copy compiled into the app build (max 90 chars). Auto-generated from title and description when omitted.

description.description: Concise summary of what the app does for audience matching (max 300 chars). Inferred automatically when omitted.
examples: Offline chromatic guitar tuner and chord library for acoustic and electric players.

developerId.description: Optional stable developer or studio identifier used to cluster sibling apps under developer_group_key (max 100 chars). Defaults to app-level grouping when omitted.

packageName.description: Real reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId (5-120 chars; official Google Play or Apple App Store URL is derived automatically; placeholders like com.example.* are rejected).

platform.description: Optional OS or framework hint. Maps android and ios directly; cross-platform values or omission fall back to automatic OS inference.

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

title.description: Human-readable app title shown in banners (max 80 chars). Inferred from packageName when omitted.

name: adomatic_onboard_app
